## Summary by CodeRabbit

- Refactor
  - Streamlined transfer handling during accumulation to ensure cleaner state progression and reduce potential carry-over between steps.

- Tests
  - Removed version-dependent test exclusions, providing consistent and predictable test coverage across environments.

- Developer API
  - Added a method to retrieve and clear pending transfers in one step, enabling more controlled processing flows.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough
Removes GpVersion-based conditional in the test runner. Alters AccumulationStateUpdate to make transfers mutable and adds takeTransfers() to return-and-clear transfers. Updates accumulateSequentially to consume transfers via takeTransfers(), modifying how transfers propagate between sequential steps.

## Changes
| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| **Test runner gating removal**<br>`bin/test-runner/w3f.ts` | Removed import of Compatibility and GpVersion; eliminated version-based conditional that previously altered ignored vectors. |
| **Accumulation state mutation + API**<br>`packages/jam/jam-host-calls/externalities/state-update.ts` | transfers field changed from readonly to mutable; added takeTransfers() to return current transfers and clear the list. |
| **Accumulate flow consumption change**<br>`packages/jam/transition/accumulate/accumulate.ts` | accumulateSequentially now calls stateAfterParallelAcc.takeTransfers() instead of reading .transfers directly. |

## Sequence Diagram(s)
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant Accumulate as accumulateSequentially
  participant State as AccumulationStateUpdate
  participant Parallel as ParallelAccumulate

  Note over Accumulate,State: After parallel accumulation completes
  Accumulate->>Parallel: runParallelAccumulate(...)
  Parallel-->>Accumulate: stateAfterParallelAcc (with pending transfers)

  Accumulate->>State: takeTransfers()
  Note right of State: Returns transfers and clears internal list
  State-->>Accumulate: newTransfers

  alt newTransfers not empty
    Accumulate->>Accumulate: recurse with newTransfers
  else no transfers
    Accumulate->>Accumulate: proceed to next phase/end
  end
```
